fields.Participants: TA Marketing, Recruiting (links to VS-19.1), Store Ops (links to VS-07), L&D (links to VS-19.4), Apprenticeship (links to VS-123), DEI (links to VS-103.2), Marketing (links to VS-14)

workflows.name: Campus, University & Vocational School Partnership & Early-Career Pipeline

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "tracks, and regional schools near store/DC locations" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "capture leads into talent CRM" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to TA governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-594 (ensure controlled execution — Talent Community, Campus Pipeline & TA Analytics (PA-121.3).)
- operational: school-ROI analytics; operational: CRM capture + nurture (links to W3770)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Low-yield risk**: Expensive partnerships with poor conversion; mitigated by school-ROI analytics
- **Pipeline-disconnect risk**: Campus leads never nurtured; mitigated by CRM capture + nurture (links to W3770)
System Touchpoints: - Talent CRM (links to W3770); L&D/apprenticeship (links to VS-19.4/VS-123); loyalty/marketing (links to VS-14); analytics (links to VS-28.1); data privacy (links to VS-91)

steps.activity: TA Marketing/Early-Career define the campus and school-partnership strategy: target universities (business, supply chain, IT, engineering), technical/vocational schools and TESDA partners (for trade-knowledgeable frontline — links to VS-123), senior-high/shs-partner tracks, and regional schools near store/DC locations; map partnerships to BuildRight's talent segments and growth regions

TA Marketing execute campus engagement: career fairs, on-campus employer branding, classroom/club sponsorships, BuildRight store/DC tours and immersion, case competitions, and internship/OJT placement (links to VS-19.1/W179 cadetship); capture leads into talent CRM (links to W3770) with consent
TA Marketing/Analytics measure campus-pipeline yield (interns → conversions, school ROI, early-career retention) and report to TA governance (links to W3784) and CHRO

fields.Participants: Early-Career, L&D (links to VS-19.4), Recruiting (links to VS-19.1), Store Ops (links to VS-07), HR (links to VS-103), Compensation (links to VS-102), TA Marketing

workflows.name: Management Trainee / Cadetship Program Design & Talent-Brand Integration

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "track cohort performance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-594 (ensure controlled execution — Talent Community, Campus Pipeline & TA Analytics (PA-121.3).)
- operational: differentiated brand and EVP; operational: sponsor/mentor model and placement governance
Pain Points / Risks: - **Attract-risk**: Program cannot attract top cadets vs larger/branded employers; mitigated by differentiated brand and EVP
- **Placement-risk**: Cadets complete but are not placed well; mitigated by sponsor/mentor model and placement governance
System Touchpoints: - L&D (links to VS-19.4/W179); talent CRM (links to W3770); rewards (links to VS-102); analytics (links to VS-28.1); workforce planning (links to VS-103.3)

steps.activity: Early-Career/L&D design the management-trainee/cadetship program (operational execution is W179 in VS-19.1 — this owns the *design, brand, and pipeline*): target segments (future store managers, merchants, supply-chain, digital), rotation curriculum, mentor/sponsor model, success criteria, and the talent-brand positioning that attracts top cadets

TA Marketing/Early-Career market the program: high-touch campus and CRM campaign (links to W3777/W3770), selective assessment (links to W3772), compelling offer (links to VS-102/W3773), and a visible "cadet → leader" alumni story
Early-Career/Analytics track cohort performance (completion, placement, retention, promotion velocity) and feed insights to program design and to workforce planning (links to W3784/VS-103.3)

fields.Participants: TA Marketing, HR (links to VS-19.1/W682), EX (links to VS-103.2), L&D (links to VS-19.4), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Comms (links to VS-14.3)

workflows.name: Internal Mobility Marketing, Talent Marketplace & Career Pathing Communication

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-post of "posting workflow is W682 in VS-19.1 — this owns the *marketing and marketplace…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-communication of "communicate career-pathing, reskilling, and growth stories to existing employees" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to CHRO and DEI governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-594 (ensure controlled execution — Talent Community, Campus Pipeline & TA Analytics (PA-121.3).)
- operational: marketplace and communication; operational: equity measurement
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden-opportunity risk**: Employees unaware of internal roles → avoidable attrition; mitigated by marketplace and communication
- **Equity risk**: Mobility access uneven across the 205 locations; mitigated by equity measurement
System Touchpoints: - Internal talent marketplace (links to VS-103.3); L&D (links to VS-19.4); cross-entity transfer (links to W511); EX/comms (links to VS-103.2/VS-14.3); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: TA Marketing/EX/HR build the internal mobility marketing and talent marketplace: visible internal career paths (cashier → supervisor → store manager; stock associate → DC lead; store → HQ), an internal job marketplace/gig platform, and proactive communication of open internal roles (the transactional posting workflow is W682 in VS-19.1 — this owns the *marketing and marketplace experience*)

TA Marketing/L&D communicate career-pathing, reskilling, and growth stories to existing employees (links to W3766 advocacy), enabling cross-entity/cross-region moves (links to W511) and reducing regrettable attrition

TA Marketing/Analytics measure internal-mobility health (internal-fill rate, mobility velocity, equity of access across entities/regions/gender) and report to CHRO and DEI governance (links to VS-103.2/W3784)

fields.Participants: TA Operations, EX (links to VS-103.2), HR (links to VS-19.5), TA Marketing, Data Privacy (links to VS-91), Analytics (links to VS-28.1)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "TA Operations/EX stand up the alumni/boomerang program" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate rehire eligibility per policy" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to TA governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-594 (ensure controlled execution — Talent Community, Campus Pipeline & TA Analytics (PA-121.3).)
- operational: alumni program; operational: eligibility validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Lost-talent risk**: Strong former employees never re-engaged; mitigated by alumni program
- **Rehire risk**: Re-hiring a previously-poor performer; mitigated by eligibility validation
System Touchpoints: - Talent CRM (links to W3770); separation (links to VS-19.5); data privacy (links to VS-91); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: TA Operations/EX stand up the alumni/boomerang program: at separation (links to VS-19.5), capture consented alumni contact and a positive offboarding (links to W3776), maintain an alumni record/talent-CRM segment (links to W3770) with RA 10173-compliant consent and retention (links to VS-91)

TA Operations/TA Marketing run alumni engagement and boomerang recruiting: periodic BuildRight updates, alumni events, and proactive outreach to eligible former employees for fitting openings (boomerang hires have higher retention and lower ramp cost); validate rehire eligibility per policy
TA Operations/Analytics measure boomerang contribution to hires, retention, and time-to-productivity vs external hires, and report to TA governance (links to W3784)

fields.Participants: TA Marketing, HR (links to VS-19.1/W715), Finance (links to VS-17.4), EX (links to VS-103.2), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Compliance (links to VS-22)

workflows.name: Referral Program Marketing, Incentive Design & Operations

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "tracking, and equitable access across all 205 locations" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "report to TA governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-594 (ensure controlled execution — Talent Community, Campus Pipeline & TA Analytics (PA-121.3).)
- operational: continuous marketing and easy tooling; operational: diversity sourcing balance (links to W3767)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Low-participation risk**: Program exists but is underused; mitigated by continuous marketing and easy tooling
- **Bias/clique risk**: Referral-heavy hiring reduces diversity; mitigated by diversity sourcing balance (links to W3767)
System Touchpoints: - HR/payroll (links to VS-19.2/W715); internal comms (links to VS-103.2/W716); employee app (links to VS-75); analytics (links to VS-28.1); finance (links to VS-17.4)

steps.activity: TA Marketing/HR design and refresh the referral program marketing and incentive structure (the reward *processing* is W715 in VS-19.1 — this owns the *marketing, design, and channel*): tiered incentives, role-priority bonuses for hard-to-fill segments, easy-share referral links and tracking, and equitable access across all 205 locations

TA Marketing market the program continuously (internal comms links to VS-103.2/W716, manager advocacy, success stories, leaderboards) and make referral submission frictionless via the mobile/employee app (links to VS-75)

TA Marketing/Analytics measure referral yield (share of hires, quality/retention of referrals, cost-per-hire, program participation rate), process rewards (links to W715), and report to TA governance (links to W3784)

fields.Participants: TA Operations, IT (links to VS-27/VS-113), Enterprise Architecture (links to VS-113), HRIS (links to VS-103.3), Data Privacy (links to VS-91), Master Data (links to VS-29), Finance (links to VS-17.4)

workflows.name: TA Technology Stack, ATS/CRM Integration & Candidate-Data Governance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "manage the TA technology stack" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "consent and purpose-limitation, retention/deletion" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-124 (ensure lawful & consented candidate data handling.)
- operational: integration and candidate-master governance; operational: RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fragmented-data risk**: Candidate data spread across tools with no single view; mitigated by integration and candidate-master governance
- **Privacy-breach risk**: Candidate data mishandled/leaked; mitigated by RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - HRIS/ATS (links to VS-103.3); enterprise architecture (links to VS-113); data privacy (links to VS-91); master data (links to VS-29); IT operations (links to VS-27); ITAM (links to VS-99)

steps.activity: TA Operations/IT/EA manage the TA technology stack: ATS, talent CRM, career-site/CMS, assessment/scheduling, background-check, sourcing tools; integration to HRIS/payroll (links to VS-103.3/VS-19.2) and SSO/identity (links to VS-27.3), aligned to enterprise architecture (links to VS-113)

TA Operations/Data Privacy govern candidate data: candidate master/record, data minimization, consent and purpose-limitation, retention/deletion per RA 10173 (links to VS-91), DSAR handling for candidates, and secure transfer/share with agencies (links to W3768/VS-91)
TA Operations/IT assure TA-system performance, availability (links to VS-27.1), and data quality (candidate record completeness/dedup), and manage TA vendor lifecycle/SLA (links to W3768/VS-99)

fields.Participants: TA Lead, Compliance (links to VS-22), Legal (links to VS-100.3), HR (links to VS-19/VS-103), Data Privacy (links to VS-91), Audit (links to VS-21), DEI (links to VS-103.2)

workflows.name: TA Compliance, Equal-Opportunity, Consent & Audit Readiness

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "TA Lead/Compliance/Legal maintain TA compliance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "capture, retention, DSAR, breach handling, and lawful agency data-sharing" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "TA Lead/Audit support TA audit and regulatory inspection" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-124 (ensure lawful & consented candidate data handling.)
- operational: EEO policy and structured assessment (links to W3772); operational: RA 10173 governance
Pain Points / Risks: - **Discrimination risk**: Biased hiring creates DOLE/legal exposure; mitigated by EEO policy and structured assessment (links to W3772)
- **Privacy-non-compliance risk**: Candidate data handled unlawfully; mitigated by RA 10173 governance
System Touchpoints: - Compliance (links to VS-22); legal (links to VS-100.3); data privacy (links to VS-91); audit (links to VS-21); labor relations (links to VS-84); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: TA Lead/Compliance/Legal maintain TA compliance: equal-employment-opportunity policy, lawful job advertisements, lawful pre-hire checks (links to W3772), compliant offer/contract terms (links to VS-100.3/W688), anti-discrimination, and DOLE/labor-law alignment (links to VS-22/VS-84)

TA Lead/Data Privacy ensure candidate consent and data-privacy compliance throughout the funnel (RA 10173 — links to VS-91): consent capture, retention, DSAR, breach handling, and lawful agency data-sharing (links to W3768)
TA Lead/Audit support TA audit and regulatory inspection (DOLE, NPC), manage findings to closure, and report compliance posture to audit (links to VS-21) and governance (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: TA Lead, Analytics (links to VS-28.1), People Analytics (links to VS-103.3), HR (links to VS-19/VS-103), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Strategy (links to VS-33), CHRO

workflows.name: TA Analytics, Workforce-Planning Linkage & Strategic Talent Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-forecast of "TA Lead/People-Analytics link TA to strategic workforce planning" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report strategic talent insights to the executive committee and board…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-124 (ensure lawful & consented candidate data handling.)
- operational: linkage and executive reporting; operational: supply/demand modeling
Pain Points / Risks: - **Siloed-analytics risk**: TA metrics disconnected from workforce planning and business strategy; mitigated by linkage and executive reporting
- **Forecast-accuracy risk**: Hiring plans misaligned to actual demand; mitigated by supply/demand modeling
System Touchpoints: - Analytics/BI (links to VS-28.1); people analytics (links to VS-103.3); succession (links to W178); strategy (links to VS-33); governance/board (links to VS-36); ESG/sustainability (links to VS-25.3)

steps.activity: TA Lead/Analytics maintain the TA analytics suite: funnel (links to W3776), source/channel ROI (links to W3763/W3768), employer-brand health (links to W3765), talent-community/CRM yield (links to W3770/W3780/W3781), diversity (links to W3767), quality-of-hire and early-attrition linkage (links to VS-103.3)

TA Lead/People-Analytics link TA to strategic workforce planning (links to VS-103.3): supply/demand by role/region/entity, build-vs-buy decisions, succession bench (links to W178), and store-opening/expansion staffing forecasts (links to VS-37/VS-33.1)

TA Lead/CHRO report strategic talent insights to the executive committee and board talent/sustainability lens (links to VS-33.2/VS-36/VS-25.3), and translate into TA strategy, EVP, and budget actions (links to W3761/W3768)
